name: entity-usage-captures
goal: A clean verification runs the Used In and Uses specs through the scenario wrapper and records a fresh stamped screenshot of every required surface

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At f13 the two workspace usage specs pass as plain checks but no scenario names them: verifyPlan gives them no wrapper check, the scenario requires no usage capture, and their picture helper records no evidence. Expected: a verification runs both through the wrapper and requires seven stamped screenshots

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unmodified f13 sources, specs and fixture byte-identical. test/entity-usage-captures.test.ts (sha e978ecde): 5 failed, the plan holds no scenario check for either spec and no usage capture is required. packages/desktop/test/entity-usage-capture.test.ts (sha 307459d0): 2 failed, 1 control passed. work/entity-usage-captures/red

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: desktop-renderer gains six required states, two wrapper checks, three full-page screenshot evidences and the workspace-route unit, bound both ways; verification-targets maps both specs to entity-usage. The usage fixture records a picture as its state's evidence; the spec gains one picture call at the former address. No assertion, action or product source changed

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same tests, sha e978ecde and 307459d0: 5 and 3 passed (work/entity-usage-captures/green). Working tree at f13, build 90ede891 from build:desktop and verify stamp: both wrapper commands exit 0, 3 and 2 tests; the real gate passes all seven screenshots and two outputs (work/entity-usage-captures/wrapper). Not a sealed record. Ordinary browser run: 5 passed

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Prove that an omitted state, a missing capture or a weaker hook fails the regressions.
steps.evidence: Scratch copy, eight mutations, each fails a frozen test: mapping removed, a state not required, viewport capture, unit unbound, unstamped build recorded, any revision recorded, a picture unmapped, sections not awaited (work/entity-usage-captures/mutants). On copies of the real captures the gate rejects an omitted line, a missing file, another revision, another build and another width
